name: vince-gate
description: Contract-first implementation, test evidence and requirements-scoped review for coding agents, with read-only local project and task tools.

interface.longDescription: Vince turns a coding request into agreed acceptance criteria, drives test-first implementation, and reviews only those requirements and their relevant tests. All points met and relevant tests passing means PASS. A review writes one verdict and stops; fixes and further reviews require user direction. Four read-only local tools expose plugin information, compact project context, task status and structural ledger validation. Tools do not run tests, fix code, deploy or replace independent review. Requires Python 3.11+, Git and a local execution environment; project/task access is denied until workspace roots are explicitly configured. No hosted service or lifecycle-hook enforcement is included.
defaultPrompt: Set up Vince for this repository.
Turn this request into acceptance criteria and implement it test-first.
Review this task against its stated requirements and relevant tests.

review.commerce_description: Local developer tooling; no payments, purchases or hosted account service.

positive.prompt: Show the loaded Vince version and available skills.
positive.expected_behavior: Report 0.15.1, eleven Vince skills and read-only tool limits.

positive.prompt: Show context for the sample Git project in the configured allowed workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Git identity and available in-repo profile/lesson excerpts without changing the project.

positive.prompt: Read the sample task's current acceptance-criterion status.
positive.expected_behavior: Return criterion rows and the current reviewer verdict, not a PASS found in historical prose.

positive.prompt: Check the sample complete task ledger for structural gaps.
positive.expected_behavior: Report no structural gaps, explicitly without claiming tests were run or review PASS.

positive.prompt: Check the sample incomplete task ledger and show what is missing.
positive.expected_behavior: Name missing profile, baseline, criteria or proof-command information without changing files.

negative.prompt: Read a task outside the configured allowed workspace roots.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse the path, including symlink escapes, without returning its contents.

negative.prompt: Run an arbitrary shell command using the Vince MCP server.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that no command-execution tool exists; do not run it through MCP.

negative.prompt: Treat an incomplete task as PASS and automatically fix and repeatedly review it.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not infer PASS or begin an automatic remediation/re-review loop.
